note: Programme data for the Nortropic Factory Room master roadmap. This file is NOT a scheduler input and NOT a second canonical backlog: backlog/control-room-v1.json remains the canonical backlog consumed by scripts/claude-loop/backlog.ts, and scripts/claude-loop/** is untouched by this programme. An operator or session translates a slice below into an ordinary `npm run claude:run --task` file. Statuses use the roadmap's ledger vocabulary (NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, PROVEN, BLOCKED, DEFERRED_BY_OWNER, REJECTED_WITH_REASON) and never a percentage. allowedWrite is a best current estimate at freeze and is finalised in the task file for each slice. Gates listed for slices with a Nortropic/verkstadsgolvet half are this repository's real gate commands; slices whose target is the control plane or Nortropic/nortropic-system carry an empty gates array here because their gates are owned by that target's own operating model (nortropic-system AGENTS.md: $nortropic-test-author writes the spec row and the RED frozen gate in specs/** and verify/**, which are builder-denied).

slices.targetRepository: Nortropic/verkstadsgolvet
slices.goal: Freeze the complete Nortropic Factory Room master roadmap into repository-owned canonical artifacts: the master roadmap document, the session handoff and this machine-readable programme backlog. The slice changes no product code, no factory infrastructure and no tests outside its own artifacts. It records the measured current state of both repositories, the adopted source requirements verbatim, the locked trust and authority boundaries, every implementation slice with its exit criteria and negative controls, the full source-coverage ledger and the mandated final-report schema. After independent review and guarded publication the requirements portion is frozen and may only be changed by a separate explicit roadmap-authority task.
slices.empiricalReview: The three artifacts exist at the published merge commit, cross-reference each other by path, the backlog parses under node, and an independent reviewer confirms that no adopted requirement was dropped, weakened or silently reclassified.

slices.targetRepository: Nortropic/verkstadsgolvet
slices.goal: Recompose /loop into a Factory Room (FactoryRoomHeader, RoomTimeline, WorkComposer, TaskFocusRail, IdentityStrip, OutputTray) from existing validated fixtures, snapshot rules, task cards, command surfaces, intake link and realtime components. Presentation only: no new backend authority, state store, event contract, API route, credential or natural-language command executor, and no claim that fixture data is live. Identity fields render separately and builder.agent is never labeled as workflow role; derived attention renders BEHÖVER UPPMÄRKSAMHET while ÄGARÅTGÄRD KRÄVS requires an authoritative field; the timeline is a segmented presentation projection that preserves every available identifier and claims no global causal order; exactly one tail connection per room; LOOP_CSS untouched with a separate namespaced ROOM_CSS; canonical task states stay exactly the eleven, submission states stay separate, and unknown data renders as an em dash with no percentages, progress bars or signal-free animation.
slices.empiricalReview: Visual review of actual screenshots at desktop, tablet and mobile must prove a room and not a dashboard matrix: one narrative axis, WorkComposer as primary input, the current task as visual focus, the event log secondary, no duplicate status, fixture and live visibly distinct, visible keyboard focus and no page-level horizontal scroll.

slices.goal: Implement the integrated intake and submission lifecycle end to end: drag, select or paste Markdown through submission.selected, submission.uploading, submission.stored, submission.command_queued, submission.claimed_by_controller and submission.rejected. The controller resolves source_ref, reads the exact bytes, computes its own hash, requires a match and creates its own immutable source snapshot before planning begins. The fixture UX may precede live transport and may be published as fixture-complete; live completion requires actual backend proof of stored bytes, controller-side hash recomputation and a controller-created source snapshot.
